svg.title: Kubernetes: control plane to packets
svg.desc: One kubeadm control plane and three workers. All nodes run containerd, Cilium, standalone Envoy, and Hubble.

g.text: One kubeadm control plane and three workers. All nodes run containerd, Cilium, standalone Envoy, and Hubble.
Each worker VM • k8s-node-01 / 02 / 03 • edge label
CNI / Kubernetes IPAM • Service translation without kube-proxy • network policy
Pod CIDR 10.244.0.0/16; /24 per node | Service CIDR 10.96.0.0/12
etcd peer port 2380 stays control-plane-only. API / kubelet are private; HAProxy is a separate LXC, outside the cluster.
